notes.title: Digital Artbook now available!
notes.content:
[i][b]Our Digital Artbook is now available![/b][/i]
Get your hands on the digital artbook for a behind-the-scenes look at the art and process notes from our design team!
Includes:
[list]
[*] Process Diary from our lead Artist, B7o7u7n7c7y!
[*] Behind the scenes images of concept art
[*] HD wallpapers (1920x1080) of all Happy Endings from The Noob Adventures: Fool for Love video game (contains spoilers)
[*] An [i]EXCLUSIVE[/i] wallpaper, not seen in the base game
[*] A copy of all the backgrounds that were prepared as part of the game, including some never-before-seen backgrounds
[/list] 

Each sale primarily supports our artists and the Noob Adventures server!

notes.title: April 1st Update Notes!
notes.content:
A huge THANKYOU to you all for your kind words, feedback and love for our game!

This update is small, but has some important fixes:
- Updated typos in a couple of story lines,
- A secret character was being too secretive and can now very rarely be found in game.
